text.p: Australian bonds slightly underperformed other dollar bloc bonds as the local market found resistance pressing ahead with its recent strong rally in the absence of fresh key economic data.

U.S. Treasuries followed through Tuesday's bid tone in Tokyo trading after the fall in both October housing starts and the latest Redbook chain stores report, and despite a mildly disappointing two-year note sales.
The U.S. faces a US$12.5 billion five-year note auction later today, along with international trade data for September.

The local market was also mildly outpaced by Canadian debt, which while firm with the U.S. market, was stunted sligtly at the short-end after the Canadian CPI was not a benign as expected and was seen detering the Bank of Canada from easing policy.
